## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/17

## What to build

Establish that the laptop staging prototype reproduces the agreed production watch experience and has the required simulator, replay, live-wheel and owner-review evidence before any watch deployment.

Follow the settled behavior and evidence boundaries in the parent specification. Verify observable application outcomes through explicit actions, raw notifications, session transitions and controlled time where applicable; retain scenario, expected/observed result, provenance and artifact references. Reuse existing evidence within its demonstrated scope.

## Acceptance criteria

Apply [Local preset editing, navigation and editable defaults](https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43), which supersedes the wheel-owned editor in #41/#42. Review Jump, Forest, Road and Drag as editable defaults, lossless schema migration, entirely local drafts with whole-editor Save/Cancel from active keypads, swipe-up hierarchy and wrapping left/right fields. Preset Clear and per-field Set/Done are absent. Only the separate riding preset menu applies saved included values to the wheel; saving locally is never wheel confirmation.

- [ ] Provide documented launch/shutdown/offline-relaunch instructions and reproducible, exportable/importable scenario definitions stored in the XDG data area, with deterministic seeds/time and clearly labelled higher-level injections.
- [ ] Review complete watch-sized flows through the actual UI/backend boundary: dashboard/freshness, navigation/sleep, alert editing and traces, local preset editing, defaults, Save/Cancel and gestures, retained preset application/outcomes and button horn behavior. Laptop/watch synchronization and transfer are withdrawn. Desktop shortcuts do not substitute for watch interactions.
- [ ] Exercise simulator scenarios, read-only recording replay and browser/session/storage failure cases. Collect evidence incrementally; simulator review may proceed before hardware evidence is complete.
- [ ] Obtain required live application evidence for telemetry/cadence, included control mappings/ranges and fresh confirmation, required persistence, complete multi-setting/partial/disconnect behavior and implementation behavior while riding. Preserve the owner's moving-support report as planning evidence, not a stopped-only product restriction.
- [ ] Complete the relevant outstanding evidence tracked by existing #9, including authorized audible horn result/variant/latency/duration/repeated presses/alarm coexistence and changed assist/dip persistence. Already-valid observations need not be repeated merely because tickets were split.
- [ ] Retain scenario, expected/observed outcomes, relevant versions, simulator/replay/live provenance and artifact references. Preserve sanitized evidence and hashes; private recordings/backups and community archives remain off the issue tracker.
- [ ] Record explicit owner review and all required passes before declaring laptop acceptance. Unknown/failed checks remain incomplete; hardware incompatibilities are raised rather than silently changing UX, thresholds or patterns.
- [ ] This milestone requires owner participation and separate authorization for deferred horn tests, new riding experiments or other hardware operations. Its ready-for-agent label does not grant that authorization, and completion does not itself authorize watch deployment.

title: Complete laptop acceptance and retain the evidence
